title: calamophyllum cylindricum
intro: Calamophyllum cylindricum, commonly known as Mountain Horsemint, is a plant species in the family Rutaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce spasms, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in Mountain Horsemint include limonoids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
